summary: 520 Illinois Street, a five-story, ~182,800-sq-ft clinical building (Stantec architect, Clark Construction general contractor) at the corner of 3rd, Mariposa and Illinois Streets -- the owner identified this as the north portion of what this project had tracked as one combined "block 34" fragment, split 2026-09-22 along a visible roofline seam from the Illinois Street Garage immediately south of it (data/records/ucsf_illinois_street_garage.json), both built under UCSF's own "Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage" project.

milestones.text: UC Regents' Committee on Finance and Capital Strategies (May 19-21, 2020 meeting) approves preliminary-plans/working-drawings funding and scope for the Block 34 parking garage, and preliminary-plans funding for the Block 34 clinical building

open_questions: 2026-09-22, corroborating data point: this project's own DataSF business-registration spatial join (src/join_retail.py, out/retail_needs_review_approximate.csv), re-run after this record's geometry was added, shows registrations whose point-location falls inside this record's polygon listing '520 Illinois St # D2317' and '520 Illinois St # D1200' as their address -- matching the 520 Illinois St address already sourced from UCSF Real Estate's own project page, not contradicting it. The join is spatial-only and never auto-confirmed per that script's own docstring, so this is logged as corroboration, not an independent primary source.

SPLIT 2026-09-22: this record was previously mission_bay_block_34 (a probable, geographically-inferred identity for the WHOLE of a fragment that also included the Illinois Street Garage to its south). The owner directly corrected this: UCSF built three real structures where the OCII plan showed two, and Bayfront Medical Building is only the north piece of that fragment (see data/records/ucsf_illinois_street_garage.json for the south piece). The split follows a visible satellite roofline seam, not a surveyed or permitted lot line, and its exact boundary should be treated as indicative rather than authoritative.

Total project cost is reported elsewhere as approximately $335.8 million for the combined clinical building and garage; not broken out per building and not independently verified against a primary UCSF or Regents document in this pass, so left out of costs.
